doc:
# Schwarzian — JTGravity

Unformalized claims gathered verbatim from [wiphy.org](https://wiphy.org/) (query: “Schwarzian theory”).

claims.name: schwarzian_theory_studied_universal_lowenergy
claims.statement: The 1d Schwarzian theory is studied as the universal low-energy limit of Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev models using link with 2d Liouville theory.

claims.name: effective_action_syk_reparametrization_modes
claims.statement: The effective action for SYK reparametrization modes is governed by Schwarzian derivative $\{f(\tau),\tau\}$ with coefficient of order $(\beta\mathcal{J})^{-1}$.

claims.name: jt_gravity_manifold_two_schwarzian
claims.statement: JT gravity on a manifold with two Schwarzian boundaries can be written in terms of Schwarzian quantum mechanics on both boundaries, identical to the double-scaling Schwarzian limit of the full Liouville path integral.

sources.title: Fine Structure of Jackiw-Teitelboim Quantum Gravity

claims.name: schwarzian_describes_strongly_coupled_gravitational
claims.statement: The Schwarzian describes strongly coupled gravitational dynamics in the throat of near-extremal rotating BTZ black holes, which can be reduced to Jackiw-Teitelboim (JT) gravity interacting with a $U(1)$ field associated to transverse rotations.

sources.title: A universal Schwarzian sector in two-dimensional conformal field theories

claims.name: performing_dimensional_reduction_obtain_effective
claims.statement: By performing a dimensional reduction, we obtain an effective Jackiw–Teitelboim (JT) gravity theory, whose quantum fluctuations are captured by the Schwarzian action.

sources.title: Quantum Gravity Corrections to the Scalar Quasi-Normal Modes in Near-Extremal Reissener-Nordström Black Holes

claims.name: effective_action_rm_eff_frac
claims.statement: The effective action is $I_{1,\rm eff}[f] = - \frac{s_d \Phi_1}{\kappa^2} \int_0^{1/T} d\tau \, \{ \tan (\pi T f(\tau)), \tau\}$ where $\{ \tan (\pi T f(\tau)), \tau\}$ is the Schwarzian

sources.title: Universal low temperature theory of charged black holes with AdS$_2$ horizons

claims.name: flatspace_analogue_schwarzian_action_textrm
claims.statement: Flat-space analogue of Schwarzian action: $I^{\textrm{\tiny{tw}}}[h,\,g]=\kappa\int_{0}^{\beta} d\tau\,\Bigl( m\,h^{\prime\,2} - g'\bigl(i q\,h^{\prime}+\frac{h''}{h'}\bigr) + g''\Bigr)$

sources.title: Flat space holography and complex SYK

claims.name: gravity_context_nontrivial_syk_saddle
claims.statement: In the gravity context, nontrivial SYK saddle points at low energies are described by two copies of the Schwarzian theory, corresponding to a Lorentzian wormhole in bulk JT dilaton theory with periodic time identification

sources.title: A semiclassical ramp in SYK and in gravity

claims.name: onshell_action_jt_gravity_naturally
claims.statement: The on-shell action in JT gravity can be naturally reformulated as a Schwarzian boundary action.

claims.name: zero_modes_nearly_ads_acquire
claims.statement: Zero modes of nearly $AdS_2$ acquire an action determined by the Schwarzian derivative: $I = -\frac{1}{8\pi G}\int du\, \phi_r(u)\, {\rm Sch}(t,u)$ where ${\rm Sch}(t,u) \equiv -\frac{1}{2}\frac{t''^{\,2}}{t'^{\,2}} + \left(\frac{t''}{t'}\right)'$.

sources.title: Conformal symmetry and its breaking in two dimensional Nearly Anti-de-Sitter space

claims.name: correlation_functions_schwarzian_quantum_mechanics
claims.statement: Correlation functions in Schwarzian quantum mechanics can be viewed as boundary-anchored Wilson line correlators in Jackiw-Teitelboim gravity.

sources.title: The Schwarzian Theory - A Wilson Line Perspective

claims.name: schwarzian_derivative_renormalized_action_manifests
claims.statement: The Schwarzian derivative in the renormalized action manifests the conformal anomaly from time reparameterization transformations, analogous to 2D CFT.

claims.name: dirichlet_boundary_condition_both_faces
claims.statement: Dirichlet boundary condition on both faces yields defect quantum mechanics effectively described by Schwarzian action

claims.name: show_boundary_dynamics_schwarzian_mode
claims.statement: We show that the boundary dynamics is the Schwarzian mode coupled to a free particle on $U(1)$, matching the universal low-energy effective action of the complex SYK model.

sources.title: Unimodular time in JT gravity: a holographic clock

claims.name: obtain_exact_expressions_general_class
claims.statement: We obtain exact expressions for a general class of correlation functions in the 1D quantum mechanical model described by the Schwarzian action, that arises as the low energy limit of the SYK model.

sources.title: Solving the Schwarzian via the Conformal Bootstrap

claims.name: linearized_schwarzian_theory_tau_varepsilon
claims.statement: In the linearized Schwarzian theory with $\tau(u)=u+\varepsilon(u)$, the action is $I_{\mathrm{Sch}}=\frac{C}{2}\int_{0}^{2\pi}du (\varepsilon''^{\,2}-\varepsilon'^{\,2})$.

sources.title: AdS$_2$ holography and the SYK model

claims.name: schwarzian_theory_emerges_effective_description
claims.statement: The Schwarzian theory emerges as an effective description of a non-relativistic particle on hyperbolic space $H_2^+$ in a constant magnetic field $B$ in the limit $B\to\infty$.

sources.title: An exact quantization of Jackiw-Teitelboim gravity

claims.name: when_solely_focusing_contribution_surfaces
claims.statement: When solely focusing on the contribution from surfaces with disk topology, we show that the gravitational gauge theory is described by the Schwarzian theory coupled to a particle moving on the gauge group manifold.

sources.title: On 2D gauge theories in Jackiw-Teitelboim gravity
